title: Low-Pass Filter - Band 5 (850 MHz) for GPS/GNSS Anti-Jamming Filter
subtitle: Design Validation and Performance Characterization
author: Dr. Lena Kowalski

sections.1_OBJECTIVE: This document describes the design, simulation, and characterization of a Low-Pass Filter filter targeting Band 5 (850 MHz) for GPS/GNSS Anti-Jamming Filter. The filter is designed on Quartz substrate with a target center frequency of 2448.5 MHz and bandwidth of 115.3 MHz. The objective is to validate that the filter meets the required insertion loss, rejection, and linearity specifications for integration into the GPS/GNSS Anti-Jamming Filter module. This design iteration addresses feedback from the previous revision regarding out-of-band rejection improvements and temperature stability.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Filter Type: Low-Pass Filter
- Frequency Band: Band 5 (850 MHz)
- Application: GPS/GNSS Anti-Jamming Filter
- Substrate: Quartz
- Package: SiP (System in Package)
- Design Tool: Cadence AWR Microwave Office
- Design Center: Singapore RF Lab

This specification applies to all variants of the Low-Pass Filter design targeting Band 5 (850 MHz). Results are used to qualify the design for mass production release.
sections.3_DESIGN_PARAMETERS:
Center Frequency:       2448.5 MHz
Bandwidth (3 dB):       115.3 MHz
Insertion Loss Target:  <= 2.7 dB
Return Loss Target:     >= 15.0 dB
Out-of-Band Rejection:  >= 27.0 dB
Isolation (Duplexer):   >= 29.0 dB
Q Factor:               7215
Temperature Coefficient:-7.5 ppm/°C
Die Size:               2.7 x 2.3 mm
Wafer Size:             8-inch
Number of Resonators:   9
Electrode Material:     Mo
Passivation:            SiO2
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Open Cadence AWR Microwave Office and load the Low-Pass Filter template project.
2. Define the substrate stack: Quartz with specified layer thicknesses.
3. Set design targets: center freq 2448.5 MHz, BW 115.3 MHz.
4. Run initial EM simulation with 2D mesh density of 20 cells/wavelength.
5. Optimize resonator geometry using gradient descent (target IL < 2.7 dB).
6. Verify coupling coefficients between resonator stages.
7. Run 3D FEM simulation to account for package parasitics (SiP (System in Package)).
8. Export GDS-II layout for mask fabrication.
9. Fabricate prototype wafers (8-inch, Quartz).
10. Perform on-wafer probing using Keysight E5080B ENA.
11. Measure S-parameters (S11, S21, S12, S22) from 100 MHz to 7346 MHz.
12. Compare measured results against simulation and specification limits.
13. Perform temperature cycling (-40°C to +85°C) and re-measure.
14. Document results and generate summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Insertion loss at center frequency shall be <= 2.7 dB
- Return loss in passband shall be >= 15.0 dB
- Out-of-band rejection at +/- 173 MHz offset >= 27.0 dB
- Group delay variation across passband shall be <= 2 ns
- Temperature drift over -40°C to +85°C shall be <= 2.3 MHz
- Power handling shall be >= +33 dBm at 1 dB compression
- ESD tolerance >= 500 V (HBM)
- Die yield on qualification lot >= 90%
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Measurement Date:       2024-03-21
Devices Tested:         45
Insertion Loss (meas):  2.41 dB
Return Loss (meas):     16.6 dB
Rejection (meas):       30.2 dB
Isolation (meas):       34.1 dB
Q Factor (meas):        7215
Group Delay Variation:  4.9 ns
Power Handling:         +26 dBm
Die Yield:              88.7%

Result Classification:  NEEDS REVIEW
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Low-Pass Filter design demonstrated below-target performance for Band 5 (850 MHz).
b) Insertion loss met target specification.
c) Out-of-band rejection exceeded the minimum requirement.
d) Slight frequency drift observed at +85°C; TC layer thickness may need adjustment.
e) Wafer-level uniformity was excellent (sigma < 1.5%).
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
1. Review near-band rejection margin for worst-case temperature.
2. Re-run EM simulation with refined mesh for better accuracy.
3. Schedule follow-up measurement after design tweak.
